_comment: Config for the RL-based passive-client defence. The original config_cifar.json is left untouched.
_train_attacks_note: fsha and agn are supported by the simulator but excluded by default: their one-round counterfactual effect on reconstruction is positive early in training (the attacker decoder has not co-adapted yet), so they would teach the policy to accept them. They are evaluated as unseen attacks instead.
